Each SILAC experiment (forward or label-swap) is an independent transfection/pull-down ('Every bait protein was tested in at least four biological replicates (i.e., at least two forward and two reverse experiments)'). Numbered 1..n per (bait family, construct pair) in date/name order, both orientations together; APP Rep1/Rep2/Rep3 from file names and design.

Raw files _01/_02/_03 of one experiment are grouped into one MaxQuant experiment with no fraction/slice (experimentalDesignTemplate 'Slice' empty) -> repeat injections of one sample, renumbered 1..n per source (PSEN1 mut_v_ctrl has only _02 deposited -> 1; Tiffy ATXN1 IDIP mut_v_ctrl _01,_03 -> 1,2).
No fractionation: design Slice/Fraction column empty for all pull-down runs.
Every value is a vendor raw file listed in files/all (102 of 122 run files; 20 proteome runs excluded, see limitations).

Annotated by hand from the deposit, paper and search outputs, built with sdrf-tools build.
One source per SILAC channel per experiment (each channel is a separately transfected, separately labelled HEK293T population); experiment stem = raw-file name without the injection suffix.

limitations: 20 whole-proteome runs (Tiffy_20120213_FPH_APP_48h_{III,IV}_slice1-5_{01,02}.raw; MaxQuant Exp3/Exp4 in proteome_changes_APPsw.zip) are EXCLUDED: the paper says cells were 'differentially SILAC-labeled' and transfected with APP or APPsw (Fig. 6A) or APPsw+LRPPRC (Fig. 6B), but no source states which construct was light or heavy in Exp3/Exp4, nor which figure panel they are; proteinGroups shows no label swap (APP H/L 0.27/0.18, LRPPRC 0.49/0.46). Inferring the map from the measured biology would be guessing.

HTT exon-1 (HDex1, Bert_20100508) runs: no deposited experimentalDesignTemplate lists them (HTT design lists only HD506 *_2 experiments) although HTT proteinGroups.txt carries six *_1 experiments named 'Q145'/'Q23'. Table S1 gives Huntingtin (Exon1) wild-type Q23 and mutant Q79; the paper (manuscript > deposit) was followed, so mutant = 'myc-HTT exon 1 Q79 (mutant)'. The proteinGroups label 'Q145_1' contradicts this.

Light/heavy channel assignment rests on the naming convention '<A>_v_<B>' = A light / B heavy; it is explicit only in Bert_20101213_FPH_ATXN1_mutL_vs_wtH, and is otherwise corroborated per bait family by proteinGroups bait H/L ratios (bait-vs-EV experiments). For wt-vs-mutant runs the convention is assumed to hold (ratios ~1 cannot confirm it).

Injections _01/_02/_03 of one experiment were treated as technical replicates (repeat injections) of one sample: the design file groups them in one experiment with no slice/fraction, but no source says 'repeat injection' explicitly. Technical replicate renumbered 1..n per source, so it does not always equal the file suffix (PSEN1 mut_v_ctrl _02 -> 1; Tiffy ATXN1 IDIP mut_v_ctrl _03 -> 2).

Cleavage agent: both Lys-C and Trypsin are annotated on every row from the digest protocol. The 2010-2011 IP searches (MaxQuant 1.0.13.13/Mascot) used LysC specificity, and the 2013 APP search enzyme is not recorded.
SILAC Arg-10 (UNIMOD:267) is annotated for all rows because the heavy medium contained 13C6 15N4 arginine; the Supplement says the MaxQuant 1.0.13.13 IP searches used 'heavy labels: Lys-8' only.
Precursor mass tolerance not recorded for the Mascot/MaxQuant 1.0.13.13 searches nor in APP parameters.txt; column omitted.
characteristics[age], [ancestry category], [cell type] = not available (Cellosaurus: age 'Fetus', no ancestry, no cell type). Developmental stage not annotated.

The Tiffy_20110207 ATXN1 'IDIP' runs were acquired on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos (raw header), not on LTQ-Orbitrap/XL as the paper states for pull-downs; the meaning of 'IDIP' is not explained; they are annotated like the other ATXN1 pull-downs per the ATXN1 design file (empty vector vs Q82_2 etc.).

PRIDE lists disease 'Huntington disease' only and instruments LTQ Orbitrap + LTQ Orbitrap Velos; both are incomplete versus paper/raw headers. Disease is written as the cell line's ('normal'); the neurodegenerative-disease context is carried by the genotype (bait construct) values.
clinical-metadata template declared solely to license characteristics[genotype]; no clinical columns are used.
Some deposited/declared mismatch: PSEN1 design lists Ernie_20100503_FPH_PSEN1_ctrl_v_mut_01_100504032954 and mut_v_ctrl_01, which are not deposited; only deposited files are annotated.
